_provenance.local_operation: deterministic HashSLH-DSA SigGen via PKCS#11: C_CreateObject(CKO_PRIVATE_KEY, CKK_SLH_DSA, CKA_VALUE = upstream sk) then C_SignInit(CKM_HASH_SLH_DSA_<hash>) with CK_SIGN_ADDITIONAL_CONTEXT hedgeVariant = CKH_DETERMINISTIC_REQUIRED and the upstream context, C_Sign; the output is byte-compared to the upstream signature. The same tuple also drives: verify of the upstream signature (C_VerifyInit/C_Verify), a hedged (CKH_HEDGE_REQUIRED) sign+verify round-trip, and the PKCS#11 v3.2 message-based C_MessageSignInit/C_SignMessage and C_MessageVerifyInit/C_VerifyMessage pair.
_provenance.transformation: subset only; every retained field is byte-copied from the upstream file (hex case preserved); no value is re-derived and no tcId or tgId is renumbered
_provenance.subset_policy: Deterministic and exhaustive over the dimension this file exists to close: every one of the 12 external/preHash deterministic=true groups (one per parameter set) contributes exactly the 10 cases whose hashAlg has a PKCS#11 v3.2 6.69.7 CKM_HASH_SLH_DSA_<hash> mechanism, i.e. all 10 x 12 = 120 (mechanism, parameter set) pairs the HashSLH-DSA capability cells enumerate. No case is chosen by shortest message or any other tie-break because none is discarded. The two upstream hashAlg values with no PKCS#11 mechanism (SHA2-512/224, SHA2-512/256) are listed in notExecuted, as are the internal-interface groups, the external/pure groups (already carried by slhdsa_ctx_test.json and slhdsa_siggen_ctx0_test.json) and the deterministic=false preHash groups (the upstream additionalRandomness cannot be injected through CK_SIGN_ADDITIONAL_CONTEXT, so their signatures are not reproducible; hedged signing is exercised as a round-trip over this file's key material instead). One file per SLH-DSA hash family.
_provenance.retained_fields: tcId, hashAlg, sk, pk, message, context, signature (deferred dropped)
_provenance.test_only_key_material: sk values are public NIST ACVP-Server sample data, imported into a session (CKA_TOKEN=false) object and destroyed after the case; they are not secrets
